in_greek.name: Beker
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει God carrier
in_greek.long_meaning: Beker είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. From the Greek word 'Bēkos', meaning 'carrier'. In Christian tradition, it was used as a name for those who carried the holy scriptures or the Eucharist. Beker represents faith, devotion, and the importance of spreading the teachings of God.

in_latin.name: Beker
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat God carrier
in_latin.long_meaning: Beker est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. From the Greek word 'Bēkos', meaning 'carrier'. In Christian tradition, it was used as a name for those who carried the holy scriptures or the Eucharist. Beker represents faith, devotion, and the importance of spreading the teachings of God.
